title: Area & Volume
subtitle: Shapes, Prisms, Surface Area
bounds: PROTOCOL §4b measurement. Lengths 1-10 (T4 volume: one edge may be 1/2; never 1/2 elsewhere). Every × step has both factors 1-10 (a 1 only as a given length); every ÷ is exact with divisor and quotient 2-10 (halving goes through an even edge of 4+, or a product of 20 or less); + adds values to a total of 100 or less; trapezoid base sums are even and 20 or less. Every area, volume, surface area, cube count and given area is a whole number 1-100. Wrong choices up to 999.

tiers.name: Rectangles
tiers.description: Area of rectangles, squares and parallelograms: base × height.

tiers.name: Triangles
tiers.description: A triangle is half a rectangle: base × height ÷ 2.

tiers.name: Trapezoids & Sides
tiers.description: Average the bases of a trapezoid; work back from an area to a side.

tiers.name: Volume of Prisms
tiers.description: Volume = length × width × height in cubic units, half edges and half cubes too.

tiers.name: Surface Area
tiers.description: Add the areas of every face: cubes, boxes and square pyramids.

PERIMETER.student: That's the distance around. Area counts the squares inside: multiply.

ADD_SIDES.student: Area multiplies lengths. Adding them gives a length, not an area.
ADD_SIDES.teacher: Adds the given lengths instead of multiplying them.

SLANT_SIDE.student: Use the height that meets the base at a right angle, not the slanted side.
SLANT_SIDE.teacher: Multiplies the base by the slanted side instead of the perpendicular height.

NO_HALF.student: A triangle is half a rectangle: area = base × height ÷ 2.
NO_HALF.teacher: Omits the 1/2 in the triangle area formula (or in working back from it).

NO_AVERAGE.student: Add the two bases, then halve the sum, then × height.
NO_AVERAGE.teacher: Trapezoid: multiplies the sum of the bases by the height without halving.

ONE_BASE.student: A trapezoid has two bases. Average them, then × height.
ONE_BASE.teacher: Trapezoid: uses only the longer base × height.

SUBTRACTED.student: Area = side × side. Divide the area by the side you know.
SUBTRACTED.teacher: Missing side: subtracts the known side from the area.

MULTIPLIED.student: Divide, don't multiply: what times the side you know makes the area?
MULTIPLIED.teacher: Missing side: multiplies the area by the known side.

ADDED_EDGES.student: Volume multiplies the edges: length × width × height.
ADDED_EDGES.teacher: Adds the three edge lengths instead of multiplying.

MISSED_EDGE.student: You left out an edge. Volume multiplies all three edges.
MISSED_EDGE.teacher: Multiplies only two of the three edges (the base area, or ignores the 1/2 edge).

SQUARE_UNITS.student: Right number, wrong unit: volume is measured in cubic units.
SQUARE_UNITS.teacher: Correct volume reported in square units.

COUNTED_UNITS.student: Each unit cube holds 8 half-size cubes (2 × 2 × 2).
COUNTED_UNITS.teacher: Counts unit cubes when the cubes have edge 1/2.

DOUBLED_ONCE.student: Half the edge doubles the count 3 ways: 2 × 2 × 2 = 8 per unit cube.
DOUBLED_ONCE.teacher: Doubles the unit-cube count once instead of multiplying by 8.

HALVED_COUNT.student: Smaller cubes means MORE of them: 8 per unit cube, not half.
HALVED_COUNT.teacher: Halves the count because the cube edge is 1/2.

VOLUME_FOR_SA.student: That's the volume. Surface area adds the areas of all the faces.
VOLUME_FOR_SA.teacher: Computes volume instead of surface area.

ONE_FACE.student: That's one face. Surface area adds the areas of ALL the faces.
ONE_FACE.teacher: Reports the area of a single face.

FOUR_FACES.student: A cube has 6 faces, not 4: 6 × the area of one face.

THREE_FACES.student: Each face has a twin on the other side. Count all 6 faces.
THREE_FACES.teacher: Box: adds the three different faces once each, not twice.

NO_BASE.student: Don't forget the square base: add it to the 4 triangles.
NO_BASE.teacher: Square pyramid: lateral area only, base omitted.
